title: Shaking the Twin Kings
summary: In the Holy City, Ye Fan learns that An Miaoyi's refusal to dance has brought angry young talents to Miaoyu Convent, led by the Twin Kings of the Central States. When she announces she'll walk the Emperor's Road on her own, the Taiyang King attacks her; at the same time, joint kill orders from the Human World and Hell dynasties against Ye Fan light up the city. Ye Fan steps in and takes on the Twin Kings and their beast slave, which is as strong as Dragon Transformation level 5. They merge as Sun and Moon, and Ye Fan uses his Yin-Yang Life-Death Diagram and the 'Battle' Secret, which the Divine King once used on their ancestor. He shatters the Taiyang King's Bitter Sea, crippling him, and spares them at An Miaoyi's request. Ye Fan tells An Miaoyi his Dao wounds are healed, and they part as fellow travellers on the Emperor's Road. Separately, Jiang Yichen refuses to return Ye Fan's Mother of All Things Cauldron to Tingting, and Ye Fan agrees with Jiang Huairen, grandson of the bandit Jiang Yi, to take it back.
